bge_reranker.node_purpose: Re-evaluate the original Dell pricing-and-mix request against all bounded needs under ontology v1.2.
bge_reranker.input_scale: One reviewed request, ten bounded needs and at most ninety-six candidates.
bge_reranker.schema_burden: stable candidate and need identities plus cache receipt
bge_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: older reviewed evidence may remain reachable while stronger current official evidence legitimately ranks ahead
bge_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: VS1 shortlist v1.0 kept both old targets in the pool but surfaced newer direct first-party disclosures in the review head
bge_reranker.reasoning_profile: local CUDA cross-encoder; no generation, network, training or CPU fallback
bge_reranker.stop_and_truncation: 1024 tokens per pair, batch 2; fail closed on missing CUDA or contract drift

qwen_reranker.node_purpose: Provide an independent relevance signal for the same original Dell request.
qwen_reranker.input_scale: The same finite one-request candidate-need matrix.
qwen_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: a semantically close but weak disclosure must not become Evidence
qwen_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: VS1 v1.1 showed generic rerankers alone are not a financial decision layer
qwen_reranker.reasoning_profile: local CUDA shadow; no generation, network, training or CPU fallback
qwen_reranker.stop_and_truncation: 1024 tokens per pair, batch 2; fail closed on missing CUDA or contract drift

why_replay_is_required: the old targets must remain reachable without becoming a whitelist
new stronger candidates require separate human adjudication rather than result-driven weights
